changelog: - **Suggest frames no longer asks for a recompute when no suggestion is left.** After you dismissed every suggested frame, or turned the last one into a frame of your own, moving or adding a node still marked Insert ▸ Suggest frames with "the graph changed; click to recompute the suggested groups", though there was nothing left to recompute. With no suggested frame left, the row now reads just Suggest frames, as it does before the first suggestion. While a suggested frame is shown, a change to the graph still marks it as before.
